canonical_statement: Every finite multiplicative group of odd natural-number cardinality is solvable.

canonical_formal_target.fully_explicit_expression:
∀ (G : Type u) [inst : Group.{u} G] [Finite.{u + 1} G],
  @Odd.{0} Nat Nat.instSemiring (Nat.card.{u} G) → @IsSolvable.{u} G inst

domain_and_universes: G : Type u in an arbitrary universe; Group G and Finite G are ordered typeclass binders; the odd-cardinality premise is explicit; the conclusion and complete target are Prop.
hypotheses: G carries a multiplicative group structure
the carrier of G is finite
the natural-number cardinality of G is odd
conclusion: Mathlib's IsSolvable G proposition holds, equivalently some derivedSeries G n is the bottom subgroup.
minimal_import_basis: The solvability module supplies Group, IsSolvable, derivedSeries, and Subgroup; the cardinal module supplies Nat.card, Finite/Fintype cardinality transport, and oddness vocabulary. Deleting either direct import makes the complete statement module fail to elaborate. No aggregate Mathlib import, PUnit boundary import, or proof-bearing odd-order theorem is present.

checked_alternate_encodings.boundary: Replaces Finite/Nat.card by Fintype/Fintype.card without changing the group, oddness meaning, universe, or conclusion.
Replaces Odd (Nat.card G) by Nat.card G % 2 = 1 with the same ordered group and finiteness binders.
Expands IsSolvable G to existence of n with derivedSeries G n equal to bottom.
